completed.result: Firestore user-scoped learningProgress/state with safe merge and local cache compatibility
/learn is a real Learning Hub with live progression metrics and destinations
Only confirmed/in-progress/testing/resolved lifecycle states contribute to confirmed bug progression
Master Record consumes canonical Weight, Feeding and Shed services, builds interactive timeline and individual-data intelligence
/learn/topic/:id now uses canonical LearnTopic rather than the generic Knowledge Base
Knowledge Base cards now point to canonical learning topic IDs and full lessons
Tracker achievement counts are derived from canonical Firestore Snake, Weight, Feeding and Shed records
Canonical bug lifecycle and controlled transitions added with legacy Firestore compatibility
Canonical morph submission moderation transitions and approval prerequisites added; server-side approval remains authoritative
Canonical Snake save path migrates legacy data-URL photos through Firebase Storage before Firestore persistence
Shared capability resolution consolidated in Firestore rules while retaining compatibility fallbacks and deny-by-default
CreatorAdmin is the canonical Creator area; superseded Creator page/globe implementations are retired
Existing notification permission, FCM token, service worker and feeding-preparation scheduler remain the single active notification system
Confirmed unused/superseded files are preserved under retirement/ with an evidence-based manifest
Superseded morphSubmissionService.ts removed from active source after migration to canonical morphSubmission types
Creator/User/App/Security BOT workspaces now have dedicated routes, full-test mode and targeted-suite mode
Live keeper records remain read-only for tester suites; sandbox-required tests are explicitly blocked rather than falsely passed
Static route coverage audit added for declarations, duplicates, dynamic routes, redirects and unresolved navigation targets
Tester reporting distinguishes pass, fail, blocked and evidence limitations instead of converting assumptions into passes
Unified responsive modern visual layer added without creating parallel page implementations
Snake timeline exposed as a dedicated navigable surface using canonical Master Record events
Individual data coverage and Intelligence Confidence are explicit, explainable and not keeper/health ratings
